Reproducibility

Verification and provenance

The library and its independent statement compile with Lean 4.36.0-rc2. Their axiom reports contain only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound. The seven deliberate Challenge placeholders are not part of the proof.

Registered on Palomar as PALOMAR-2026-11-22-000005 (commit 5575383, November 22, 2026): hosted preflight passed, mechanical verification succeeded, and the editorial review found no blocking problem. Local fresh build, axiom audit, declaration scan and lake comparator (Lean kernel, NanoDa, con-ron) pass.

Build the project

lake exe cache get
lake build
python3 scripts/audit_axioms.py
python3 scripts/scan_axioms.py
python3 scripts/generate_challenge.py --check
lake build Challenge Solution

Build Challenge Solution before independent comparison with scripts/verify-comparator.sh.

What has been reviewed

No human expert or independent audit has reviewed the Lean statements or the proofs. Lean checks the proofs; the match between Challenge.lean and the paper is a human judgement.
